channel.title: Practical Prophets
channel.description: The Nevi'im, told as a compelling narrative. Practical Prophets retells the Jewish Bible's prophetic books as richly researched, novel-like nonfiction: the events, characters, political stakes and moral questions of Tanakh, grounded in the Hebrew text and Jewish tradition. Each 30–40-minute episode follows one prophet's story without mixing different prophets. A separate commentary voice explores Hebrew language, historical context and traditional interpretations. The biblical narrative remains the source; commentary and historical uncertainty are identified as such.

item.title: The River and the Promise
item.description: Joshua 1–5. Moses has died. Joshua must lead Israel across the Jordan and into the land. Two spies meet Rahab in Jericho, the river crossing transforms Joshua's standing, twelve stones preserve the story, and Israel's first Passover in Canaan marks the end of the wilderness era. Based on the Masoretic Hebrew Bible, with Jewish commentary presented in a distinct narrator voice. Content note: biblical conquest, conflict and references to violence.
